cases.purpose: A private terminal emulator tracks 1000, 1015 and 1006, generates each click from the current active encoding, then confirms mode disable inhibits reports.

cases.oracle: Private software emulator implements XTerm 1000 tracking and 1006/1015/X10 encoding precedence; fixed hand-computed event vectors and a stub consumer are mandatory setup controls. The shell consumer reads actual PTY bytes and invokes the mouse decoder. No physical device is opened.
cases.comparison: Per-phase mode set, actual emitted protocol record, disabled mode, consumer status and final terminal modes; raw transcript and transition/injection timeline retained. A missing phase is reported FAIL rather than claimed as exercised.
